name: In-Between Frame (Morph) synthesizes intermediate tween keyframes with SDF optical flow
description: Verify the in-between framing AI engine: draws a solid ball in top-left on Frame 1, draws a solid ball in bottom-right on Frame 2, triggers '+ In-Between Frame (Morph)' from PixiBud AI, asserts a 3rd intermediate frame is created, and verifies the transitional shape sits halfway along the motion vector.

planSteps.description: Select the Ellipse tool (press O), ensure shape mode is 'Shape: Filled Solid', and draw a solid circular ball in the upper-left quadrant of the canvas on Frame 1
Select Flood Fill (press G), choose an amber color, and click inside the circle to solidly fill it
Verify Frame 1 contains the filled ball in the upper-left corner
Click the 'Frame' button in the bottom timeline bar to add Frame 2
On Frame 2, select Ellipse (O), draw the ball in the lower-right quadrant of the canvas, and fill with the same amber color
Verify the timeline currently contains exactly 2 keyframes
Click the Frame #1 selector in the timeline thumbnail strip to set it as active
Click the 'PixiBud AI' tab button in the right inspector panel
Verify the COLOR SCIENCE & MORPHING section is displayed
Click the '+ In-Between Frame (Morph)' action button
Verify the timeline frame count automatically increases from 2 to 3 frames
Verify the newly inserted middle frame (Frame #2) contains an interpolated tween shape situated along the diagonal path between the start and end positions
Click the 'PLAY' button in the bottom timeline bar
Verify the 3-frame sequence plays as a smooth, continuous interpolated animation loop
